title: s2u-pack.json, format version 2, at engine contract 0.2 (s2u-pack)
description: A creator pack's manifest (the pack framework v2, XT-1; contract 0.2, FX-5; a browser adaptation with no original), s2u-pack.json at the pack's root. This schema is the manifest's shape only, for editors; the contract's validator (packages/creator-contracts/src/packs.ts, validatePack) is the authority: it also checks the build's target and contract, every member's bytes against its row, the intents' cover, the dependencies and the handler claims against the build, the rules floor, the 0.2 fields' contract floor (a pack using license, authors, extensions or a row's provenance states a range admitting no engine before 0.2.0) and that no string anywhere names a URI.

id.description: 1-64 of a-z, 0-9, dots and hyphens, a letter or digit at each end, no '..'; not beginning mod., model. or texture. (the earlier formats' adapters own those).

target.description: The disc revision the pack is for: exactly the build's (SCUS-97275 today).

contract.description: A SemVer range that at least one engine contract version the build reads must satisfy (0.1.2 and 0.2.0 today).

kinds.description: plugin is reserved (OT.R118): a pack holding it states sides server and a 0.2 contract, and no page applies it.

options.description: Plain JSON handed to the handler: at most 4096 bytes, nested at most 2 deep.

license.description: Contract 0.2. One SPDX licence id, by its shape only (CC0-1.0, MIT, GPL-2.0+, LicenseRef-...); no expression. Inside the pack hash.

authors.description: Contract 0.2. The authors' display names, in their order: printable ASCII, no e-mail address and no link. Inside the pack hash.

extensions.description: Contract 0.2. One object of tools' own data, keyed by reverse-dotted names (org.example.tool), never interpreted by the game; at most 16384 bytes of canonical JSON, no URI anywhere inside. Inside the pack hash.

packRef.description: A pack's identity (PackRef): its id, its SemVer version and its hash, the pack digest.

path.description: Relative, forward slashes, at most 240 characters and 16 folders deep; not s2u-pack.json or a Thunderstore root file.

provenance.description: Contract 0.2. Where the member came from: original, or derived from a named pack or from a file the player supplied ('import'). A member declared extracted (game content off a disc) is refused in every context, so it is not a shape this schema admits. Inside the pack hash.
